description: This file declares classes and interfaces related to the implementation of RunC containers within a process container framework, including the RunCContainer class and its administrator.

classes.name: RunCContainer
classes.description: Represents a container managed via the RunC runtime, providing methods to control and query container state.

classes.name: RunCContainerAdministrator
classes.description: Manages multiple RunCContainer instances, providing container creation and logging functionalities.

methods.name: RunCContainer(const string& id, const string& path, const string& logPath)
methods.description: Constructor initializing a RunCContainer with specified identifiers and paths.

methods.name: ~RunCContainer()
methods.description: Destructor for cleanup of RunCContainer resources.

methods.name: Pid()
methods.description: Returns the process ID associated with the container.

methods.name: IsRunning()
methods.description: Checks if the container is currently running.

methods.name: Start(const string& command, IStringIterator& parameters)
methods.description: Starts the container with a specified command and parameters.

methods.name: Stop(const uint32_t timeout)
methods.description: Stops the container, waiting up to the specified timeout.

methods.name: Memory()
methods.description: Retrieves memory information of the container.

methods.name: ProcessorInfo()
methods.description: Retrieves processor information of the container.

methods.name: NetworkInterfaces()
methods.description: Retrieves network interface information of the container.

methods.name: InternalPurge(const uint32_t timeout)
methods.description: Performs internal cleanup or purge operations for the container.
